summary: Tested Dependency Graph visualization and timestamp features. Most features working correctly: Dependencies tab visible, graph nodes render with status/priority, legend shows blocking vs resolved, project created_at timestamp in header, task created_at and updated_at timestamps in modal. CRITICAL BUG: Graph edges/arrows not rendering due to missing Handle components in custom TaskNode.

ui_bugs.issue: Graph edges/arrows not rendering. React Flow error: 'Couldn't create edge for source handle id: undefined'. Custom TaskNode component is missing Handle components from reactflow which are required for edges to connect to nodes.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Add Handle components to TaskNode: import { Handle, Position } from 'reactflow'; then add <Handle type='target' position={Position.Left} /> and <Handle type='source' position={Position.Right} /> inside the TaskNode component div.

passed_tests: Dependencies tab visible with Network icon
Graph nodes render for each task
Nodes show task title, status badge, and priority indicator
Nodes show checkmark icon for done tasks
Nodes show circle icon for todo tasks
Graph legend shows 'Blocking (in progress)' with orange line
Graph legend shows 'Resolved (done)' with green line
Zoom controls render on left side
Click on graph node opens task detail modal
Project created_at timestamp visible in header ('Created Jan 20, 2026')
Task created_at timestamp visible in modal ('Created Jan 20, 2026 at 11:37 AM')
Task updated_at timestamp visible in modal ('Updated X minutes ago')
Timestamps use CalendarClock and History icons
failed_tests: Graph edges/arrows between dependent tasks not visible - React Flow Handle components missing
action_items: HIGH: Fix DependencyGraph.jsx - Add Handle components to TaskNode for edges to render.
